inject.title: Unhurried Is Now in the WordPress Theme Directory
inject.core_topic: Our free block theme Unhurried passed the WordPress.org review and can now be installed from inside WordPress.
x:
Unhurried, our free WordPress block theme, is now in the official WordPress.org theme directory.

Search "Unhurried" under Appearance, Themes, Add New.

https://switchcasestudio.com/blog/unhurried-is-in-the-wordpress-theme-directory
inject.ig_caption: Unhurried, our free WordPress block theme, passed the WordPress.org review. You can now install it from inside WordPress: Appearance, Themes, Add New, search Unhurried. Thank you to the volunteer Themes Team for the careful read.
ig_slides: Unhurried is in the WordPress theme directory
